**Currently allowed origins** (CORS config in `worker/src/index.ts`, inside `app.use('*', cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} }))`):
- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any subdomain ending in `.pages.dev`
- any subdomain ending in `.workers.dev`

**Where to add a new custom domain:**
File: `worker\src\index.ts`, in the `origin` function passed to `cors()` (around line 20). Add a new condition, e.g.:
```ts
origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com' ||
```
or an `.endsWith('.your-custom-domain.com')` check for subdomains, inside the same `if (...)` block before `return origin;`.

Note: Hono's `cors()` treats array entries as literal strings only — wildcards require this function form, as documented in `docs\DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` (§4 CORS) and `worker\src\index.md`.
